reports.title: Eaton Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Results, with Strong Organic Growth, Accelerating Record Orders and Backlog; Raises Organic Growth Guidance

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: For the full year 2026, the company anticipates:

desk.headline: Record sales up 28% to $8.9bn and adjusted EPS $3.68, beat; full-year organic growth guidance raised to 13–15%
results: Sales hit a record $8.9bn, up 28%: 19% organic growth, 8% from acquisitions (mainly Boyd Thermal) and 1% currency.
Adjusted EPS rose 20% to a record $3.68; GAAP EPS was $2.77 after $0.62 of amortisation and $0.30 of deal costs.
Electrical Americas sales rose 22% organically to $4.2bn with a 29.8% margin; Electrical Global sales jumped 58% to $2.7bn.
Orders keep climbing: rolling 12-month orders up 39% in Electrical Americas and 51% in Electrical Global; Electrical backlog up 46%.
Free cash flow was $1.03bn; Eaton agreed to buy Italy's COL Group for €810m to add European capacity.

guidance.summary: Eaton raised its 2026 organic growth range to 13–15% and lifted adjusted EPS to $13.70–13.80, above the $13.60 analysts expected; the segment margin range is unchanged.

points: Data centre sales rose 65% and data centre orders roughly doubled; total Electrical backlog is above $20bn.
Demand is spreading beyond data centres, with machine-builder and utility orders also up strongly.
18 of 25 capacity expansions are done, and Electrical Americas incremental margins are expected to rise sharply in Q4.
Boyd Thermal's 2026 revenue view was raised to $1.9bn; no Boyd-sized deal is planned in the next 12 months.
Risks flagged: high inflation, aerospace supplier shortages slowing deliveries, and the timing of data-centre power design changes; 2027 guidance comes in February.
call.source: Call transcript: The Motley Fool, 3 Nov 2026; consensus: InvestorsHub via Finviz, 3 Nov 2026

watch: Whether Electrical Americas margins recover as new capacity ramps in Q4.
Aerospace supply-chain constraints on converting backlog.
Closing of the Mobility–Dana deal and the COL Group purchase in early 2027.
